method: Whole-file manual reading of SelectDrivesDlg.h (199 lines) and cpp (718 lines); pinned bytes verified. No Windows execution.
findings: Drive queries use packaged_task, shared_future and detached workers capturing path by value. Static GUI-thread registry reuses pending queries across dialog reopen, erases ready queries on a later StartQuery. Workers do not reference dialog or item pointers.

No query timeout, cancellation or concurrency limit appears here. A permanently blocked path can retain its pending query and worker across reopens. Dialog teardown does not wait for these workers; this is a lifecycle tradeoff, not proof of successful query completion.
GUI polls every100ms, consumes ready futures with exception handling, clears local future and stops timer when none remain. Used-space ratio guards total zero and free greater than total.

All Local Drives excludes remote, SUBST and MTP entries, but does not filter by successful accessibility query; selected-subset admission also does not require query success. Scan-time error handling remains separate.

Folder OK validation accepts any UNC-prefixed part without querying existence; local paths use DoesFileExist. SaveSelection normalizes paths and updates bounded case-insensitive history. This layer does not prove directory-only admission or atomic path stability.
Folder GetSelectedItems returns one joined specification string for downstream splitting. Manual drive selection persists separately from actual all/subset scan roots.

Elevation request snapshots persisted settings, invokes SaveSelection with ignored boolean result, requests elevation then restores previous settings and writes them. Actual elevation, failure and restart semantics were not executed.

Selection changes are suppressed during initial population and sorting, preventing programmatic sort notifications from switching to subset mode. MTP discovery and shell icon fetch occur during GUI population; this source alone does not establish bounded startup latency.
limits: No drive, MTP, UNC, timeout, worker-lifetime, elevation or GUI runtime tests performed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
